note: The OLG extensively covers the Simplified Reporting IR process on the 'Simplified Reporting – Interim Report' page, including: (1) BEACON automatically mails IR forms 45 days before the certification midpoint; (2) a Warning Notice is sent if the IR is not returned within 20 days; (3) a closing notice follows 10 days later; (4) the case closes automatically at the certification midpoint for 'Failure to Complete an Interim Report'; (5) procedures for reinstating untimely or incomplete IRs within 30 days; (6) fault determination (Department vs. client) is automated in BEACON. The OLG also addresses incomplete reports: sections left blank for Contract Information and Household Members are 'not considered incomplete,' and workers must attempt contact and send a VC-1 for incomplete, questionable, or contradictory information. However, several FNS 751 concepts are not addressed: (a) the OLG does not discuss what happens if the agency fails to send the mandatory report form (FNS says the household must be determined ineligible — the OLG assumes BEACON always sends it); (b) there is no guidance on handling a returned-but-missing report form; (c) the FNS completeness framework (e.g., forms designed for change-only responses, categorical eligibility exemptions from answering certain questions, combined-program forms where only SNAP questions matter) is not reflected in the OLG's simpler 'blank sections' guidance; (d) there is no mention of quarterly or monthly reporting — Massachusetts appears to use only Simplified Reporting for SNAP. The OLG's coverage is operationally strong for the normal IR workflow but does not address the edge cases and error scenarios that FNS 751 requires reviewers to evaluate.
